task.title: Enforce canonical UTF-8 at Emacs gateway boundaries
task.objective: Reject invalid encoded gateway JSON bodies and complete SSE lines before semantic decoding
acceptance_criteria: Complete JSON response bodies are canonical UTF-8 before JSON decoding
Complete SSE lines are canonical UTF-8 while valid sequences may span chunks
Malformed, non-canonical, surrogate, out-of-range, and raw preserved bytes fail closed

attempts.summary: Added hostile ERT coverage for invalid UTF-8 in gateway JSON and ignored SSE fields
attempts.diagnostic: An ignored SSE field containing overlong UTF-8 was silently accepted

attempts.summary: Validated canonical UTF-8 at complete JSON-body and complete SSE-line boundaries

outcome.summary: Gateway text now fails closed before field interpretation while preserving valid fragmented UTF-8 and JSON CRLF whitespace

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1074

lessons: Validate bytes at the narrowest complete-text boundary so transport fragmentation remains legal
Unknown protocol fields must still pass encoding validation because ignoring semantics must not bypass the wire contract
